title: Suppression of Terrorist Activities Special Courts Amendment Act 1993

sections.shortTitle: Suppression of Terrorist Activities Special Courts Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1993
ACT I OF 1993
SUPPRESSION OF
TERRORIST ACTIVITIES (SPECIAL COURTS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to
amend the Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th January, 1993]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 24th
January, 1993 and is hereby publisher: for general information:---
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Suppression of Terrorist
Activities (Special Courts) (Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Suppression of Terrorist Activities Special Courts Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Amendment of section 5-A, Act XV of 1975

ACT I OF 1993
ACT I OF 1993
SUPPRESSION OF
TERRORIST ACTIVITIES (SPECIAL COURTS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1993
An Act further to
amend the Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) Act, 1975
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th January, 1993]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 24th
January, 1993 and is hereby publisher: for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 5-A,
Act XV of 1975.-----In the Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special
Courts) Act, 1975 (XV of 1975), in section 5-A,---
for subsection (8), the following
shall be substituted, namely:-
"(8) An accused person shall
not be released on bail by a Special Court or by any other Court, if there
appear reasonable grounds for believing that he has been guilty of a scheduled
offence; nor shall an accused person be so released unless the prosecution has
been given notice to show cause why he should not be so released."
